interpretation: Report all eight candidates on the shared July20-Aug16 DEVELOPMENT panel. Primary point metric: mean absolute error in Fahrenheit, first averaged within each UTC target day then equally across days. Also report root mean squared error, quantile pinball loss, central 80%/90% interval coverage and width, and station/horizon counts. Paired differences against persistence use the same cases and day grouping; no station-hours treated as independent trials. No promotion, profitability, market beating or untouched validation claim follows.
limitations: Actual source receipts occurred September6,2026 and are preserved. The 15-minute historical publication/label lag is an unverified sensitivity assumption, not a reconstructed receipt. This study is retrospective development, including pretrained-model release and training-data overlap uncertainty.

All 37 IDs and timezones in the pinned station directory, including empty stations. The 31 stations with some raw history are a coverage fact, not an error-selected subset. Source array positions are never station identities; no hourly market-index or exchange contract mapping is inferred.

One fixed Chronos supervised fit through adapter.FIXED_FIT only; no RL, hyperparameter search, checkpoint choice, validation input or silent retry. Report completed steps and budget interruption explicitly; an incomplete fit cannot be relabeled as a completed 200-step candidate. Ridge penalties 1/10/100 are separate registered candidates and all are reported.
